proofs.text: Make the fake host refuse the first tree request with HTTP 403 and the header `Retry-After: 1`; verify the wait taken is 1 second, that the line `The git host asked for a pause of 1 s.` is printed, that the tree request is sent a second time and the commit sha comes back. Repeat with `x-ratelimit-reset` set 30 seconds ahead and no `Retry-After`; verify the wait is between 25 and 30 seconds. Repeat with `Retry-After: 900`; verify the wait is exactly 120 seconds. Repeat with HTTP 429 and `Retry-After: 2`; verify the wait is 2 seconds and the commit sha comes back. Refuse every tree request with `Retry-After: 1`; verify 4 tree requests were made, 3 waits were taken, and `HTTPError` is raised with code 403 and `403` in its message. Refuse every tree request with no header at all; verify one tree request, no wait, and the refusal raised

rule_text: A REST call the git host refuses with 403 or 429 while naming how long to wait, in `Retry-After` seconds or the `x-ratelimit-reset` epoch, waits that long, no longer than 120 seconds, prints one line saying so and is sent again, up to 3 times before the refusal is raised; a refusal naming no wait is raised on the first answer

def test_a_refusal_that_asks_for_a_pause_is_waited_out_and_retried(
        project, github_env, monkeypatch, slept, capsys):
    host = FakeHost(refuse_trees=1, refuse_headers={'Retry-After': '1'})
    monkeypatch.setattr(urllib.request, 'urlopen', host)
    path = records_module.write_record(project, record(), 'ci')

    sha = records_module.commit_records(project, [path], 'ci',
                                        'purlin: record')

    assert sha == 'c' * 40
    assert host.trees == 2, 'the refused tree request was not sent again'
    assert slept == [1.0]
    assert 'git host asked for a pause of 1 s' in capsys.readouterr().out
